basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old software engineer from Austin, Texas, who recently discovered the world of skincare. When I'm not coding or debugging, I enjoy exploring new skincare products and routines. My journey into skincare started when I realized that long hours in front of the screen were taking a toll on my skin. Besides skincare, I have a keen interest in 3D printing, and I love experimenting with my Anycubic Photon printer. I'm single, and my typical online hours are late evenings after work. I'm always eager to learn more about skincare and enjoy engaging in discussions with fellow enthusiasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in skincare is quite new, primarily gathered from online resources like Reddit and skincare blogs. I have a technical background in software engineering with a degree from the University of Texas. I'm self-taught in 3D printing and frequently visit subreddits like AnycubicPhoton to enhance my skills.
